scope: Primary method/summary readings, not systematic review or author-code reproduction

before_protocol.title: Multivariate Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting with Correlated Errors
before_protocol.read_level: HTML introduction, sections3.2 and4.1 methods; not all experiments/proofs
before_protocol.implication: Temporal neural GLS is prior art; this prototype is not an original-paper replication

before_protocol.title: Marginal Regression Analysis of Longitudinal Data With Time-Dependent Covariates: A Generalized Method-of-Moments Approach
before_protocol.read_level: publisher search-return summary; not full paper
before_protocol.implication: Covariate dependence restricts valid estimating equations; causal moment validity is not a new theorem

before_protocol.title: A cautionary note on inference for marginal regression models with longitudinal data and general correlated response data
before_protocol.authors: Margaret Sullivan Pepe; Garnet L Anderson
before_protocol.read_level: publisher abstract/search text, not full paper
before_protocol.implication: Correlated-response working covariance requires assumptions with time-varying covariates

after_results_supplement.title: Train Like a (Var)Pro: Efficient Training of Neural Networks with Variable Projection
after_results_supplement.implication: Exact linear readout plus learned features is not a novel generic algorithm

after_results_supplement.title: Smart Forecasting of Carbon Prices Using Machine Learning and Neural Networks: When ARIMA Meets XGBoost and LSTM
after_results_supplement.read_level: publisher abstract; also found before protocol as background, date rechecked after results
after_results_supplement.implication: Ordinary hybrid forecast averaging already carbon prior art; no paper gains used as our results

after_results_supplement.title: Forecasting Carbon Price Trends With Image-Based Convolutional Neural Networks
after_results_supplement.implication: Direction/trend classification is not our point-price target

after_results_supplement.read_level: publisher abstract only, not method audit
after_results_supplement.implication: Time-varying output weights and joint estimation already exist; do not rename baseline
